outcome: mental health difficulties (Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire - SDQ)
mindfulness awareness levels (Mindful Attention Awareness Scale - MAAS)
cohort: Adolescent patients with subclinical Hashimoto's thyroiditis were studied, comparing those with and without levothyroxine (LT4) use.
finding: Levothyroxine alone did not affect mental health or mindfulness scores, but higher TPOAb titers correlated positively with behavioral problems, and higher TgAb levels correlated inversely with awareness levels.
